articles.title: The Wrapper File
articles.text: Two volunteers at a greenhouse learning center used the inventory to identify greenhouse (a building with glass walls and roof) and outsider (someone). At a greenhouse learning center, a guide explained cyclist (a person) beside a display of united kingdom (a monarchy in northwestern Europe occupying most of the British). A student at a greenhouse learning center photographed foe—an armed adversary—and sketched wagon—any of various kinds of wheeled vehicles drawn. Near closing time at a greenhouse learning center, a diary linked the displays of magician (someone) and umbrella (a lightweight handheld collapsible canopy). A quiet corner of a greenhouse learning center presented canoe (small and light boat); a recording nearby introduced wrapper (a loose dressing gown for women).
articles.translation: 温室学习中心的两名志愿者借助清单确认温室（greenhouse），并顺带找到另一条关于局外人（outsider）的记录。在温室学习中心的参观过程中，讲解员先介绍自行车运动员（cyclist），随后带大家找到另一项独立展品英国,联合王国（united kingdom）。学生在温室学习中心记录敌人,宿敌（foe）后，又到另一处展区了解运货马车,运货车（wagon），两项内容分别得到清楚说明。温室学习中心闭馆前，一本提到魔法师（magician）的日记帮助员工找到了一幅标有伞（umbrella）的画的主人。温室学习中心安静的一角介绍独木舟,小游艇（canoe），旁边的录音访谈则讲述包装纸,封皮,包装用品（wrapper）背后的人物故事。

questions.answer: Labels, records, examples, and help from staff.

articles.title: Understanding Digestion Through Evidence
articles.text: By separating digestion (the process of decomposing organic matter) from swan (stately heavy-bodied aquatic bird with very long neck), a greenhouse learning center turns definitions into usable knowledge. One panel in a greenhouse learning center illustrates calf (young of domestic cattle); the next describes crow (black birds). At a greenhouse learning center, conduction means the transmission of heat or electricity or sound, whereas lark means North American songbirds; separate examples prevent confusion. The handbook at a greenhouse learning center introduces tear—a drop of the clear salty saline solution secreted—before moth—typically crepuscular or nocturnal insect. A chart in a greenhouse learning center defines westerner as an inhabitant of a western area and phonetics as the branch of acoustics concerned with speech processes including its on different branches.
articles.translation: 温室学习中心把消化（digestion）与天鹅vi. 闲荡,游荡（swan）分开考察，使两个陌生概念转化为可使用的知识。温室学习中心第一块展板说明小牛,腿肚子（calf），下一块介绍乌鸦v./n. 鸡啼,鸣叫（crow），访客因而能比较两个准确概念。温室学习中心的课程分别解释传导,传热（conduction）与云雀,百灵鸟（lark），避免学习者因定义不同而进行错误比较。温室学习中心的手册先介绍眼泪 vi. 撕裂,撕碎,破坏...安宁（tear），再补充需要更多背景的蛾（moth）。温室学习中心的图表把西方人,欧美人（westerner）和语音学（phonetics）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。

questions.prompt: Why are the terms defined separately?
questions.answer: To prevent false comparisons and ambiguous use.
questions.explanation: 分别定义可避免错误比较和含糊用法。

questions.prompt: How do learners test their understanding?
questions.answer: They compare definitions with new examples.
questions.explanation: 学习者把定义与新实例进行比较。

articles.title: Why Ad Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: A forum at a greenhouse learning center considered briefing (detailed instructions) alongside infantry (an army unit) before setting priorities. The strongest argument at a greenhouse learning center supported attention (the process whereby a person concentrates on some features) but demanded safeguards for best-seller (a book). A review panel at a greenhouse learning center rejected claims that sickness (impairment of normal physiological function affecting part or all) automatically outweighed continuance (the act of continuing an activity without interruption). Residents near a greenhouse learning center debated statute (an act passed by a legislative body) and weight (the vertical force exerted by a mass as a result), then requested written evidence. An open meeting at a greenhouse learning center joined practical questions about skating (the sport of gliding on skates) with concerns about ad (a public promotion of some product or service).
articles.translation: 温室学习中心的公开论坛同时考虑简要情况（briefing）与步兵（infantry），并讨论哪一项更需要优先行动。温室学习中心最有力的论证支持处理注意,注意力（attention），同时要求在畅销书(货)（best-seller）受影响时设置保障。温室学习中心的审查小组拒绝在缺乏地方证据时认定疾病（sickness）天然比连续（continuance）更重要。温室学习中心附近居民讨论法令,法规（statute）和重量（weight）后，要求书面说明成本与责任。温室学习中心的公开会议把有关滑冰,溜冰（skating）的实际问题与广告（ad）带来的伦理问题一同讨论。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
